THE MANGLO STORY

Good work deserves
good tools.

Not another complicated platform. Manglo is a focused place to prepare product images, understand selling numbers and learn the practical details that help independent work move forward.

WHAT WE BELIEVE

The details should feel easier.

Independent sellers have enough to manage. Beautiful product photos, accurate pricing and clear listings shouldn't require expensive software or another dashboard to learn.

We build simple, useful tools around real tasks: compress a photo, choose a format, understand the margin or check a promotion before it goes live. Our Playbook explains the thinking behind those actions.

Explore all seven tools →
INDEPENDENT WORK / MADE MORE APPROACHABLE
THE PRINCIPLES

Built around what matters.

01 / CLARITY

One clear job at a time.

Each tool has a purpose and explains what it does. No overwhelming dashboard or unexplained settings.

02 / PRIVACY

Files stay on your device.

Our image tools process photos inside your browser rather than uploading them to a Manglo server.

03 / ACCESS

Useful without an account.

All seven tools are currently free. Our practical guides are open to everyone, with examples for sellers in India and worldwide.
